assumption_notes: Thin metal skins and carriers replace thick printed panels in these budgets. Their material, stiffness, local ribs, insulation and fastening are not designed here.
The 6 mm custom cooling budget includes contact plate, interfaces, pipe and mounting-height allowance above the CPU. It is a design allocation, not a selected or qualified cooler.
A 68 mm fan pocket does not include confirmed tabs, wiring or every part of a supplier shroud. The full fan drawing can enlarge the board changes.
The remote heatpipe corridor is a reservation, with no selected forming radii, vertical transition or qualified transport capacity. It intersects the proposed radio area.
The 11 mm cell and 5 mm trackpad thicknesses are still nominal/assumed. Retain 1 mm cell padding and 3 mm swelling space.
The panel is still assumed 3.5 mm. All closed heights exclude feet and any extra hinge or fastener protrusion.
Repositioning radio mounting hardware beneath the deck is required even when the radio stays over the cell. Existing tall screw heads are not silently retained.

The 5.2 mm socket is an optional study. Electrical equivalence, exact module seating, footprint, retention, insertion sweep and underside clearance remain unverified. The current 8 mm socket is unchanged.
Passing the separate scalar height budgets does not prove that their reserved volumes can coexist. None of these concepts is a finished assembly.
